notes: All five packet elements are rmw C API functions with side 'consumes'. At this revision rclcpp calls none of them directly. Which rmw functions those rcl wrappers invoke is defined in rcl, outside the snapshot and outside the allowed sources, so no port is recorded for any element (ports list only direct publish/offer/subscribe/call). publisher_base.hpp:19 and publisher_base.cpp:18 include <rmw/rmw.h>, which declares these functions, but no call follows; the only direct rmw call on the publisher is rmw_get_gid_for_publisher. api:rmw_event_set_callback is listed in references because the public header event_handler.hpp:158 names it in a doxygen \sa and the tests name it in comments; it is a documentation/comment reference, not a call. api:rmw_create_publisher, api:rmw_destroy_publisher, api:rmw_event_fini and api:rmw_publisher_event_init are not named anywhere in the snapshot, so they are in neither references nor declares/not_declared (declares/not_declared cover provided elements only; this package provides none of the packet elements).
